setlist_extra.title: That's It For The Other One

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **It Hurts Me Too** (2 reviews): Reviewer thinks this was among the first times played, and calls Pigpen the focus rather than Jerry; Disputes that it was new; the band played it as an oldie through most of 1966 [11][16]
- **Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Reviewer says Jerry dominates this hot Dew; Describes it as a Jerry and Phil duet, with Phil's accompaniment strong and Jerry not soloing [11][16]
- **Viola Lee Blues** (1 review): Reviewer cites it as the best example of Jerry's fierce guitar tone from his amp [7]
- **Good Morning Little Schoolgirl** (1 review): Rated a top-level jam along with Viola Lee Blues [13]
- **Neal Cassady** (1 review): Says the Cassady rap isn't from this show; it resembles an acid-test-style rap, probably from 7/23/67 at the Straight Theatre [5]
- **Alligator** (1 review): The final Alligator chorus before Caution appears on Anthem of the Sun [6]
- **Caution** (1 review): Pigpen's second vocal rap during this song was used on Anthem of the Sun [6]

## The recordings

- **gd67-11-10.sbd.sacks.1612.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 14 songs; 93 min; rated 4.42/5 by 48 [1]. Said about its sound: Quality is great on the first four songs excluding Hoot! Jeer!; the Neal Cassady section sounds poor; Recording sounds remarkably clear and strong for its age [7][14]
- **gd1967-11-10.116171.sbd.motb-0172.flac16**: soundboard; 10 songs; 50 min; rated 1.25/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd1967-11-10.141132.sbd.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac1644**: soundboard; 8 songs; 95 min; rated 4.8/5 by 10 [3]
- **gd1967-11-10.116368.sbd.motb-0172.flac24**: soundboard; 7 songs; 50 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- The Dead opened for Buffalo Springfield this night, which may explain the short middle set [2]
- Garcia stage talk invited the crowd to take off clothes, order pizza, catch a bus, or get high [3]
- Says the Cryptical/Other One here is sloppier than most that year [16]
- This show is included in the 30 Trips Around the Sun box set [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd67-11-10.sbd.sacks.1612.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Kirby (Chalupa) Bell; source: Soundboard [1]
- **gd1967-11-10.116171.sbd.motb-0172.flac16**: taped by Dan Healy; transferred by Matt Smith & Bob Menke Mastering By: Derek McCabe; source: Updated [2]. Also: Dan Healy reportedly ran two decks then: an 8-track at 15 ips and an Ampex at 7.5 ips [2]
- **gd1967-11-10.141132.sbd.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac1644**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: Source: 8 Track Master Reel > 1st Gen Reel (7.5ips) > PCM (Sony Beta ESXHiFi/L-750) - Given to Tim Dalton by Bob Menke; Transfer: PCM > Sony SL-10 > Sony… [3]. Also: Setlist corrected after the 30 Trips release; source credited to Tim and Charlie [3]
- **gd1967-11-10.116368.sbd.motb-0172.flac24**: taped by Dan Healy; transferred by Matt Smith & Bob Menke Mastering By: Derek McCabe; source: Updated [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by David Seabury Grateful Dead: [1967-11-11 Shrine Exposition Hall, Los Angeles, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1967-11-11-shrine-auditorium-los-angeles-ca-usa/) [23]
- Fan art by www.merchbar.com: [Grateful Dead SHRINE AUDITORIUM LOS ANGELES CA 11/10/1967 Vinyl Record](https://www.merchbar.com/rock-alternative/grateful-dead/grateful-dead-shrine-auditorium-los-angeles-ca-11-10-1967-vinyl-record-180-gram-pressing) [24]
- Fan art by Joco Records: [Grateful Dead - Shrine Auditorium Los Angeles Ca 11/10/1967 (3 LP) - Joco Records](https://jocorecords.com/products/grateful-dead-shrine-auditorium-los-angeles-ca-11-10-1967) [25]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Shrine Exhibition Hall, LA, Poster](https://www.dead.net/archives/1967/artwork/shrine-exhibition-hall-la-poster) [26]
- Photo by Zoooma (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead poster - 11/10/67 Shrine Exhibition Hall, Los Angeles](https://www.flickr.com/photos/9692677@N07/3059764666/) [27]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [gd1967-11-10front](https://www.flickr.com/photos/38838560@N04/4234238853/) [28]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/9692677@N07/3059764666/) [29]
